meta.notes: Names and descriptions use the original English text of the game. The dataConfidence field: high — several sources agree, medium — sources disagree, low — a single source.

locations: Saint Denis (market square, east side of town)
Northern Big Valley by the western map edge (north-west of Strawberry)
North-east of Riggs Station (on the mountain)
Roanoke Ridge: south-west of Annesburg, between Elysian Pool and the state border
Tall Trees (West Elizabeth): south-west of Manzanita Post by the Lower Montana River — Epilogue only
rules: The Trapper only crafts from what you have SOLD him beforehand: sell the pelts first, then order the item.
Pelts must be Perfect quality (3★ animal + clean kill).
A legendary pelt is sold once and unlocks every item made from that animal.
Besides pelts, every item costs money (the price is shown on the item card).

locations: Saint Denis — north-east, by the market (Lemoyne)
rules: Becomes available after the Chapter 2 mission "The Spines of America".
Crafting costs money; prices are not listed in this guide — check the Fence's menu.
Legendary animal parts you didn't collect go to the Fence automatically.

Not craftable (for reference): the Owl Feather trinket is a reward for "Archeology for Beginners" without killing the guards; the Iguana Scale trinket and the Eagle Talon talisman are Special/Ultimate Edition bonuses.

alligator.habitat: Swamps around Saint Denis (Bayou Nwa), riverbanks and backwaters across Lemoyne.
alligator.perfectKill: Poison Arrows or a high-powered rifle; Improved/Express ammo keeps the skin intact.
alligator.behavior: Lurks by the water and attacks if you get close.

armadillo.habitat: All over New Austin, south-west of the map.
armadillo.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
armadillo.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue (before that you're wanted there).

badger.habitat: Lemoyne, from the northern edge down to Rhodes and the Saint Denis outskirts. A guaranteed 3★ badger sits on the rocks behind the Trapper's shop near Riggs Station.
badger.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
badger.behavior: Predator: Predator Bait lures it out. Often active at dusk and at night.

bear.habitat: Mountains and forests of Ambarino (The Grizzlies) and the wooded slopes of West Elizabeth.
bear.perfectKill: High-powered rifle (Rolling Block / Springfield) with Express ammo, or Poison Arrows; kill with one or two headshots.

black_bear.habitat: Forest in Big Valley (West Elizabeth) and the woods north of Annesburg. Potent Predator Bait helps.
black_bear.perfectKill: Poison or Improved Arrows, or a rifle; aim for a one-shot kill.

beaver.habitat: Riverbanks: near the letters "E" and "R" of NEW HANOVER (Kamassa River, Butcher Creek) and Owanjila lake in West Elizabeth.
beaver.perfectKill: Bow with regular arrows, Repeater or Rifle (the Varmint Rifle also gives a clean kill).
beaver.behavior: Stays by the water, dives when threatened.

bison.habitat: West of Blackwater (Great Plains) and the Heartlands floodplain south-west of Annesburg.
bison.perfectKill: Poison Arrows or a high-powered / Sniper Rifle, headshot.
bison.behavior: Herd animal. Very tough — headshots only.

boar.habitat: Woods all over Lemoyne, especially around Bluewater Marsh and south of Rhodes.
boar.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

buck.habitat: Lemoyne and northern New Hanover near the Ambarino border. Very common.
buck.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.
buck.behavior: Skittish; use Herbivore Bait and approach from downwind.

bull.habitat: Farms: north of Saint Denis near Lagras; just north of the "H" in NEW HANOVER; just north of the "E" in WEST ELIZABETH.
bull.perfectKill: Poison or Improved Arrows, or a Rifle.
bull.behavior: May charge. Farm livestock — the owner may attack you, so go at night.

collared_peccary.habitat: New Austin: past the railroad east of Benedict Point.
collared_peccary.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

cougar.habitat: South of Blackwater by the river; the western edge of West Elizabeth by the map border; in the Epilogue, south of Tumbleweed above the riverbank.
cougar.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

cow.habitat: Farms north of Saint Denis along the coast; Painted Sky ranch above the Dakota River (2 cows in the pen).
cow.behavior: Farm livestock — the owner may attack you, so go at night.

coyote.habitat: Eastern New Hanover, from south of Van Horn to north of Annesburg; around Rhodes.
coyote.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, Repeater or Rifle.

deer.habitat: Woods of Lemoyne and eastern Ambarino. Best spot: the open meadows between Rhodes and Bolger Glade.
deer.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

elk.habitat: Cold areas: Ambarino and north of Annesburg.
elk.perfectKill: Poison Arrows or a high-powered / Sniper Rifle, headshot.

fox.habitat: Woods of Ambarino and Lemoyne. Reliable spot: near the letters "BER" in CUMBERLAND FOREST.
fox.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, Repeater or Rifle.

gila_monster.habitat: New Austin, near the letters "A", "S" and "T" of NEW AUSTIN.
gila_monster.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
gila_monster.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

goat.habitat: Just north of Saint Denis along the coast; Larned Sod ranch below the "H" in NEW HANOVER (always has a 3★ goat, best at night).
goat.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.
goat.behavior: Domestic: the owner may attack you.

iguana.habitat: Before the Epilogue: only on the northern part of the island off the east shore of Flat Iron Lake (2–3 iguanas). In the Epilogue: common in New Austin.
iguana.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.

moose.habitat: Between the letters "I" and "N" of AMBARINO; north of Annesburg by the map edge; Cairn Lake and around Colter. In the Epilogue: Tall Trees.
moose.perfectKill: Poison or Improved Arrows, a Rifle, or a Shotgun with Slug shells.
moose.behavior: Rare before the Epilogue: use Potent Herbivore Bait.

muskrat.habitat: Drying creeks: Dewberry Creek (north of the "E" in LEMOYNE), north of Annesburg, west and south of Strawberry.
muskrat.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.

opossum.habitat: North of Annesburg; the northern shores of Flat Iron Lake; near the "W" in WEST ELIZABETH.
opossum.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.

ox.habitat: Ranch shack north-west of Van Horn (east of Butcher Creek) — always a 2★ or 3★ ox there; north of Braithwaite Manor; north and east of Rhodes.
ox.behavior: Ranch livestock — the owner may attack you.

panther.habitat: South of Rhodes by the river, south-east of Braithwaite Manor (woods near Old Harry Fen); north of Saint Denis, above the "N" and "E" of LEMOYNE.
panther.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.
panther.behavior: Very dangerous, attacks without warning. Shows up more at night — save before hunting.

pig.habitat: Farms east of Saint Denis; north of Flat Iron Lake, below the first "N" of NEW HANOVER. Any breed of pig works.
pig.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, Repeater or Rifle.
pig.behavior: Domestic: the owner may attack you.

pronghorn.habitat: Around the word "NEW" in NEW HANOVER and south towards Flat Iron Lake; western West Elizabeth past Hanging Dog Ranch, above the "W" of WEST ELIZABETH.
pronghorn.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

rabbit.habitat: Around Valentine, Strawberry, Rhodes and Saint Denis, often near roads.
rabbit.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.

raccoon.habitat: Lemoyne, New Hanover and West Elizabeth — near water and woods.
raccoon.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.

ram.habitat: Mountains of Ambarino and West Elizabeth; the open ledge by the railroad south of Cattail Pond (above the Cumberland Falls label).
ram.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

rat.habitat: Best: the Saint Denis docks; also West Elizabeth and northern Lemoyne. Bait helps.
rat.perfectKill: Bow with Small Game Arrows (or the Varmint Rifle).
rat.behavior: Small and fast, needs a precise shot.

sheep.habitat: Ambarino and northern West Elizabeth by the western map edge (often together with Bighorn Rams); in the Epilogue, around Tumbleweed.
sheep.perfectKill: Bow with regular or Poison Arrows, or a Rifle.

skunk.habitat: All of Lemoyne; eastern New Hanover; the western edge of West Elizabeth.
skunk.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
skunk.behavior: Sprays when approached. Mostly at night.

snake.habitat: The road from Saint Denis to Van Horn and Annesburg (Predator Bait helps); water snakes in the swamps near Lagras.
snake.perfectKill: Bow with Small Game Arrows, headshots only.

squirrel.habitat: Woods near Strawberry, north of Annesburg, Ambarino, West Elizabeth. Lots of squirrels in the north-west corner of the map past Hanging Dog Ranch.
squirrel.perfectKill: Bow with Small Game Arrows (or the Varmint Rifle).

wolf.habitat: Above the "O" in AMBARINO; the three-way crossroads north of Hanging Dog Ranch (a pack attacks at night).
wolf.perfectKill: Rifle with Express ammo, headshot; or Bow with regular or Poison Arrows.
wolf.behavior: Hunts in packs and attacks. More active at night.

robin.habitat: Around Valentine, Strawberry, Rhodes and Annesburg.
robin.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

oriole.habitat: Just north of Rhodes; the north-west shore of Flat Iron Lake and the island east of it.
oriole.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

raven.habitat: Around Blackwater; between the letters "E" and "M" of LEMOYNE.
raven.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

woodpecker.habitat: Woods of West Elizabeth and Ambarino.
woodpecker.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

chicken.habitat: Wild chickens where NEW HANOVER is written on the map; around Blackwater. Killing farm chickens is a crime.
chicken.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

goose.habitat: North-west shore of Flat Iron Lake; near the letters "N" and "O" of NEW HANOVER.
goose.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
goose.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

hawk.habitat: West of Blackwater by the map edge; New Austin; north-east of Annesburg.
hawk.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
hawk.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

quail.habitat: Strawberry and its surroundings; around the first "N" of NEW HANOVER.
quail.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

pheasant.habitat: Just north of the gap between NEW and HANOVER; south-west of Valentine.
pheasant.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

owl.habitat: West of Blackwater; the southern part of the island in Flat Iron Lake; north of Annesburg; north of the letters "N" and "O" of AMBARINO.
owl.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
owl.behavior: Active at night. Feathers drop at any carcass quality.

turkey.habitat: Almost everywhere; plenty in New Hanover and Lemoyne, around Van Horn and Annesburg.
turkey.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
turkey.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

eagle.habitat: Eastern Ambarino near Annesburg; north-west of the northern shore of Flat Iron Lake; the south-western edges of the map.
eagle.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
eagle.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

cardinal.habitat: Just south-west and west of Valentine (responds to any bait).
cardinal.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

rooster.habitat: Eastern outskirts of Van Horn; north and south of Braithwaite Manor. Killing farm roosters is a crime.
rooster.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

songbird.habitat: Ambarino, West Elizabeth, New Hanover, Lemoyne — town outskirts.
songbird.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

sparrow.habitat: West Elizabeth, Ambarino, Lemoyne; the northern outskirts of Valentine and Rhodes.
sparrow.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

cedar_waxwing.habitat: West of Valentine; north of Blackwater, by the letters "Z" and "A" of ELIZABETH.
cedar_waxwing.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

blue_jay.habitat: Rhodes and its surroundings; south and south-west of Valentine; Annesburg.
blue_jay.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

duck.habitat: Almost any body of water; the swamps near Saint Denis; the Annesburg area, east riverbank.
duck.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

pigeon.habitat: Southern Saint Denis; the north-west shore of Flat Iron Lake; Annesburg.
pigeon.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

crow.habitat: Lemoyne: around Rhodes and west of Saint Denis.
crow.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

vulture.habitat: Most of New Austin; northern Lemoyne near Horseshoe Overlook; south of Braithwaite Manor; between the letters "A" and "N" of NEW HANOVER.
vulture.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
vulture.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

seagull.habitat: Near any large body of water; the Saint Denis docks; the eastern edges of the map.
seagull.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
seagull.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

loon.habitat: Flat Iron Lake (eastern island, north-west shore); north and east of Annesburg; near Lagras.
loon.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.

condor.habitat: West of Tumbleweed, north of the "E" in NEW AUSTIN. Epilogue only.
condor.perfectKill: Varmint Rifle (.22 ammo) or Bow with Small Game Arrows.
condor.behavior: Feathers drop at any carcass quality — a perfect kill is not required.
condor.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

leg_bear.habitat: Grizzlies East, north of O'Creagh's Run (Ambarino).
leg_bear.perfectKill: High-powered rifle with Express ammo, Dead Eye, shots to the heart / head.
leg_bear.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_bear.unlock: First encountered in the Chapter 2 mission "Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego" (with Hosea). You can come back at any time after the mission.

leg_beaver.habitat: Butcher Creek by the Kamassa River (Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover), west of Van Horn Trading Post, just south of the "E" in NEW HANOVER.
leg_beaver.perfectKill: Barely fights back — any weapon, one shot is enough.
leg_beaver.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_ram.habitat: The hills east of Cattail Pond, near Valentine (between the pond and the Dakota River; on the New Hanover / Ambarino border).
leg_ram.perfectKill: Not very tough — Rifle, shot to a vital spot.
leg_ram.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_boar.habitat: South of Bluewater Marsh — north of the "S" in MARSH and the "A" in BLUEWATER.
leg_boar.perfectKill: Charges right away: high-powered rifle (Springfield) or a Poison Arrow.
leg_boar.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_buck.habitat: Big Valley, south-west of the "B" in BIG VALLEY.
leg_buck.perfectKill: One Express round to the heart or head.
leg_buck.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_bullgator.habitat: Bayou Nwa, Lakay — north of Saint Denis.
leg_bullgator.perfectKill: One of the most dangerous: long-range high-powered rifle (Rolling Block), don't let it get close.
leg_bullgator.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_bullgator.unlock: First encountered in the Chapter 4 mission "Country Pursuits"; it appears on the map after that. According to GTABase, only after "That's Murfree Country". If the area isn't there, progress the story further.

leg_cougar.habitat: Gaptooth Ridge, west of Tumbleweed (New Austin).
leg_cougar.perfectKill: Very fast: full Dead Eye and a Rifle; a Shotgun up close.
leg_cougar.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_cougar.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

leg_coyote.habitat: Scarlett Meadows, just west of the "R" in SCARLETT.
leg_coyote.perfectKill: Runs off immediately: one precise shot with a high-powered rifle (Rolling Block).
leg_coyote.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_elk.habitat: Cumberland Forest, east of Bacchus Station (near Fort Wallace, by the Ambarino border).
leg_elk.perfectKill: Doesn't fight back: high-powered rifle with Express ammo.
leg_elk.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_fox.perfectKill: Runs off immediately: high-powered rifle, don't miss the first shot.
leg_fox.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_panther.habitat: Scarlett Meadows (Lemoyne), south of Rhodes: east of Braithwaite Manor and south of Bolger Glade.
leg_panther.perfectKill: The hardest one: your best rifle (Rolling Block) with your best ammo and full Dead Eye.
leg_panther.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_panther.unlock: Appears only after Master Hunter Challenge Rank 9.

leg_moose.habitat: Roanoke Ridge, by the lake north of the "R" in ROANOKE, east of Doverhill by the waterfall.
leg_moose.perfectKill: Fast and tough: full Dead Eye, Express rounds to the heart and neck.
leg_moose.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_pronghorn.habitat: Rio Bravo, by Rio Del Lobo Rock (New Austin).
leg_pronghorn.perfectKill: Very skittish: sneak up and shoot a vital spot.
leg_pronghorn.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_pronghorn.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

leg_tatanka_bison.habitat: Hennigan's Stead (New Austin): south-east of MacFarlane's Ranch, north-west of Manteca Falls.
leg_tatanka_bison.perfectKill: High-powered rifle with Express ammo; without vital-spot hits the fight drags on.
leg_tatanka_bison.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.
leg_tatanka_bison.availabilityNote: New Austin is only accessible in the Epilogue.

leg_wolf.habitat: Cotorra Springs, south of the gap between the letters "A" and "R" of AMBARINO.
leg_wolf.perfectKill: Not very tough: Rifle, shot to a vital spot.
leg_wolf.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

leg_white_bison.habitat: Lake Isabella, north-west of the "A" in AMBARINO.
leg_white_bison.perfectKill: High-powered rifle, Express ammo, accurate shots.
leg_white_bison.behavior: A legendary pelt's quality does not depend on how you kill it. The area appears on the map once you have the Legendary Animals map (Chapter 2, Hosea's mission). Inside the "?" area, find clues with Eagle Eye and follow the tracks.

materials.vintage_handcuffs: Reward from Phineas T. Ramsbottom for the first complete set of cigarette cards ("Smoking and Other Hobbies").
materials.gold_jointed_bracelet: Valuable: found when looting houses, stashes and during robberies. Don't sell it to the Fence if you need the talisman.
materials.silver_chain_bracelet: Valuable: found when looting houses, stashes and during robberies.
materials.quartz_chunk: Reward from Deborah MacGuiness for the letter about your first dinosaur bone ("A Test of Faith"). Don't sell or donate it — there is only one.
materials.gold_earring: Valuable: found when looting houses, stashes and during robberies.
materials.cobalt_petrified_wood: On a wagon north-west of Lake Isabella (Ambarino).
materials.abalone_shell_fragment: Only one in the game: the boarded-up yellow house in northern Rhodes (near the butcher) — on the workbench in the southern room. Don't sell it to the Fence if you need the talisman.
materials.silver_earring: Valuable: found when looting houses, stashes and during robberies.
materials.old_brass_compass: On the table in Francis Sinclair's cabin — after sending all 10 rock carving locations ("Geology for Beginners").
materials.lions_paw: Taken from the lion (it can't be skinned, only looted) in the Stranger mission "He's British, of Course" (part IV), near Emerald Ranch.

beaver_tooth_trinket.effect: Permanently slows degradation for all weapons by 10%.

buck_antler_trinket.effect: You receive higher quality skinned animal parts.

cougar_fang_trinket.effect: Permanently increases your Stamina experience bonus by 10%.

coyote_fang_trinket.effect: Permanently increases your Dead Eye experience bonus by 10%.

elk_antler_trinket.effect: Permanently increases the value of looted money by 10%.

fox_claw_trinket.effect: Permanently increases the time Eagle Eye can stay active by 5 seconds.

lions_paw_trinket.effect: Permanently increases your Stamina experience bonus by 10%.

moose_antler_trinket.effect: Permanently increases your Health experience bonus by 10%.

panther_eye_trinket.effect: Permanently decreases the speed that the Dead Eye bar drains by 10% for 3 seconds.

pronghorn_horn_trinket.effect: Stops animals on horseback from spoiling.

ram_horn_trinket.effect: Picking Creeping Thyme, Oregano and Wild Mint yields 2x more herbs.

wolf_heart_trinket.effect: You can drink 2x more alcohol before feeling the negative effects of being drunk.

tatanka_bison_horn_trinket.effect: Permanently decreases the melee damage you receive by 10%.

alligator_tooth_talisman.effect: Permanently decreases the speed that the Dead Eye core drains by 10%.

bear_claw_talisman.effect: Lowers the drain speed of your Health core by 10%.

boar_tusk_talisman.effect: Permanently decreases the speed that the horse Health and Stamina cores drain by 10%.

bison_horn_talisman.effect: Permanently decreases the speed that the Stamina core drains by 10%.

raven_claw_talisman.effect: Permanently slows degradation for all weapons by 20%.
